english_title: Basic Properties of This Distribution Function
statement_en: Let \((X,\mathcal{F},\mu)\) be a measure space and let \(\lambda_f(a):=\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>a\})\). Then: (1) \(\lambda_f\) is decreasing and right-continuous; (2) if \(|f|\leq |g|\), then \(\lambda_f\leq \lambda_g\); (3) if \(|f_n|\uparrow |f|\), then \(\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f\); (4) if \(f=g+h\), then \(\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)\); (5) if \(f=gh\), then \(\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})\).
callout_body:
1. $\lambda_f$是一个单调减少并且右连续的函数。
2. 如果$|f|\leq |g|$那么$\lambda_f \leq \lambda_g$
3. 如果$|f_n|\uparrow |f|$那么$\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$
4. 如果$f = g+h$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$
5. 如果$f = gh$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$
